Sean — thanks, I looked at the attendee list and Novacorp's initial itinerary. Quick notes:

- Badge approach: Recommend pre-printed visitor badges for VIPs + QR-enabled kiosk for general attendees. Pre-prints remove bottlenecks at the main lobby.
- ID checks: Novacorp requires a government ID scan for exec-level visitors; we'll collect copies on arrival and have a signed waiver (visitor-waiver.docx).
- Escorting: Jordan + myself can split the two rooms (Jordan handles main exec entry at 08:15, I'll manage overflow and last-mile escort).
- Parking/valet: Confirmed that valet will be available; give arrivals the 'Redwood' visitor code.

I've attached an updated logistics doc (onsite-logistics-v2.docx) with arrival flow and staffing assignments. I'll prepare a 1-page arrival summary for Novacorp and share by Monday morning.

One decision: does Novacorp require redundancies for badging (i.e., both a printed badge and an electronic token)? If so we should add one more on-site staff to hold spares.

Hi Sean / Marissa / Jordan — thanks for the heads-up. A few required items from facility/security:

1) Arrival windows: Please confirm exact arrival times for each VIP by name. We need to reconcile with our gate manifest a day before.
2) ID and waiver: Per our policy, executive visitors must present a government-issued photo ID; we also require a signed visitor waiver. I've attached our security requirements (novacorp-security-requirements.pdf) and a visitor waiver template (visitor-waiver.docx).
3) Badge life-cycle: We can support pre-printing badges if you provide the final CSV 24 hours in advance. Otherwise, badges will be printed at the kiosk and validated by Security.
4) Electronic access: Remote VPN or SSO access is not permitted for external execs. If you need room AV access, we can provision temporary credentials for the AV team only (no network access).

Please return the confirmed badge manifest (name, company, government ID type [last 4], arrival time) by EOD Thursday (11/26) so Security can lock the manifest.

Also, CC'ing our Security Ops for any technical questions.

Regards,
Helen Park
Senior Program Manager — Events & Facilities
NovaCorp
hpark@novacorp.com
